faq.a: Our games are not recommended for anyone under the age of seven (7). A ticket purchase is required for ANYONE entering the game, regardless of age. Alien Terror is not recommended for anyone under the age of 12. There must be at least one adult accompanying children under age 16.
Please plan to arrive fifteen (15) minutes PRIOR to your game's scheduled start time.
Your sixty (60) minute game play timer will start five (5) minutes AFTER your scheduled game time, regardless of arrival time.

faq.q: What is your cancellation / refund policy?
faq.a: There are no refunds for cancellations or no-shows. Please book responsibly.
Yes! Please call 404-999-ESCAPE (3722) or email EscapeTheNetherworld@gmail.com to reschedule. We require at least 24 hours notice to reschedule a game.

faq.q: What is the minimum number of players?
faq.a: We highly recommend groups of 4-6 players. Even one player may attempt our rooms, but there is a pricing minimum that requires a purchase of three (3) players to reserve the game. Sasquatch, Tiki Island, and Alien Terror accommodate a maximum of eight (8) players; Haunted or Nosferatu up to ten (10).

faq.q: Can my friends and I book separately?
faq.a: Payment is due at the time of booking. Games are private experiences and disappear from the website once one person has booked. If unsure of your total, reserve the minimum and add players on-site. We can not refund for fewer players than were already purchased.

faq.q: Is it scary like the haunted house?
faq.a: Our games have creepy themes and some surprise elements, but there are no actors in the rooms to scare you. Alien Terror is our most intense experience and is not recommended for anyone sensitive to darkness, motion sickness, fog, strobe lights, or loud noises.

Yes! All of our games, our lobby, and briefing room are wheelchair accessible, although a few areas within the games may be difficult to access in a wheelchair. We also have a wheelchair accessible bathroom.

faq.q: Will we really be locked in a room?
faq.a: No! The room doors are never actually locked. If you need to step out you are free to do so, but you may not be allowed to reenter. There is no refund for leaving a room early.

faq.q: I have a health condition. Is it safe to play?
faq.a: Some health conditions may pose safety risks. If you have a pace-maker, severe heart conditions, epilepsy, claustrophobia, are pregnant, or have a disability that makes standing or crawling difficult we may politely ask you not to participate. You will be in a room without seating for up to an hour.

faq.q: How does pricing work during Haunted House season?
faq.a: During the Netherworld Haunted House Season, pricing is a flat $37 per player plus taxes & fees, and games are PUBLIC. To guarantee a private room, groups must book the maximum number of spots for the room. Group package availability, rates and conditions will vary during this time.
Events held during unpublished hours can be better tailored to your schedule and accommodate larger groups. Have a large group or need a different package? Call us at 404-999-3722.
